newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Thursday, as private investors hunted for bargains after price falls during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen per kg lower to 0.8 yen firmer. Volume was 6,316 lots.
During the day, the market was pressured by profit-taking.
"It is natural for the market to go through a technical correction after recent rallies," one trader said.
Given uncertainty over the currency market for the near-term, prices are likely to consolidate at current levels for some time, the traders said.
